name: mirage-fm1
author: Leonardo Lopez Chavira
tagline: an Ensoniq Mirage for the FM-1, running Ensoniq's own OS
description: An unofficial Ensoniq Mirage sampler for the FM-1. It emulates the Mirage's hardware (the 6809, the ES5503 DOC, the eight CEM3328 filters, the floppy drive) and runs Ensoniq's own boot ROM and OS 3.2, with OS 3.2's piano, voices and strings built in.
credits: Built on fm1-base (MPL-2.0). The emulator is a C port of mirage-remake's (MIT), after MAME's enmirage and es5503 (BSD-3-Clause). The Mirage's boot ROM and OS 3.2 disk are Ensoniq's.
